summary_zh: 这是一门为期12周、共24课的网络开发入门课程，由微软云技术推广团队制作，通过动手项目讲解JavaScript、CSS和HTML基础，并配有测验、讨论和练习作业，帮助初学者开始学习编程。
audience_zh: 适合希望从零开始学习网络开发、掌握JavaScript、CSS和HTML基础的编程初学者，以及考虑在课堂中使用该课程资源的教师。

evidence.quote: 24 Lessons, 12 Weeks, Get Started as a Web Developer

Learn the fundamentals of web development with our 12-week comprehensive course by Microsoft Cloud Advocates. Each of the 24 lessons dives into JavaScript, CSS, and HTML through hands-on projects like terrariums, browser extensions, and space games. Engage with quizzes, discussions, and practical as
signments. Enhance your skills and optimize your knowledge retention with our effective project-based pedagogy. Start your coding journey today!
